note: Two-column recto body page, 1750x2180 px (ratio 0.803, not A4). body_text_size_px=20 (cap-to-baseline; line pitch 35 px). ONE UNCERTAINTY, the same kind as p025: block 3 ('Important Features of the Quantum Mechanical Model of Atom') is a single pale-green panel (#cbe7d3) that runs across the column break -- it opens at the foot of the LEFT column (y 0.692-0.912, with a dark green #00a550 top rule at y 0.6922-0.6945 that I folded into its bbox, holding the centred bold title, the intro paragraph and numbered item 1) and continues down the whole RIGHT column (y 0.120-0.856, items 2-5, closed by a dark green #00a550 bottom rule at y 0.8528-0.8555, also folded in). I put n=3 on the left-column region and n=null on the right-column continuation region rather than repeat the same n twice; the null box is the tail of block 3, not an unmatched block. The panel's centred bold title is also emitted as a nested unnumbered section_heading because it is visually distinct, although its text is part of block 3. Those two green rules are the box's own borders, NOT a rule_bar (that role belongs only to the chapter-opening divider) and not a footer_rule, so I did not emit them as band elements. Paragraph break between blocks 1 and 2 confirmed by the extra 17 px of leading and the first-line indent at x=0.1526. No page_header_band, rule_bar or footer_rule on this page: furniture is the running head (page number 54 left, CHEMISTRY right) and the centred '2024-25' footer line, labelled running_header because it is a running footer rather than the page number. A diagonal '(C) NCERT not to be republished' watermark crosses both columns; not emitted as an element.
